package processlock

import (
 "encoding/json"
 "errors"
 "fmt"
 "os"
 "path/filepath"
 "strings"
 "testing"
)

func captureLockObservations(t *testing.T) []map[string]any {
 t.Helper()
 root := t.TempDir()
 result := []map[string]any{}
 record := func(name string, err error, facts map[string]any) {
  text, kind := "", ""
  if err != nil { text, kind = strings.ReplaceAll(err.Error(), root, "<root>"), fmt.Sprintf("%T", err) }
  result = append(result, map[string]any{"name":name, "error":text, "type":kind,
   "locked":errors.Is(err, ErrAlreadyRunning), "descriptor":errors.Is(err, errDescriptorInvalid),
   "exists":errors.Is(err, os.ErrExist), "notExist":errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist), "facts":facts})
 }
 var missing *Lock
 record("nil-close", missing.Close(), nil)
 record("zero-close", (&Lock{}).Close(), nil)
 _, err := Acquire("")
 record("empty-root", err, nil)
 plain := filepath.Join(root, "plain")
 if err := os.WriteFile(plain, []byte("fixture"), 0600); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 _, err = Acquire(plain)
 record("file-root", err, nil)
 data := filepath.Join(root, "data")
 first, err := Acquire(data)
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 info, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(data, "retrom.lock")); if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 directory, err := os.Stat(data); if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 content, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(data, "retrom.lock")); if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 record("acquire", nil, map[string]any{"fileMode":fmt.Sprintf("%04o",info.Mode().Perm()),
  "directoryMode":fmt.Sprintf("%04o",directory.Mode().Perm()), "pid":string(content)==fmt.Sprintf("%d\n",os.Getpid())})
 _, err = Acquire(data)
 record("held", err, nil)
 record("close", first.Close(), nil)
 record("double-close", first.Close(), nil)
 second, err := Acquire(data)
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 after, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(data, "retrom.lock")); if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 record("reacquire", nil, map[string]any{"sameInode":os.SameFile(info,after)})
 record("close-reacquired", second.Close(), nil)
 blocked := filepath.Join(root, "blocked")
 if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(blocked, "retrom.lock"),0700); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 _, err = Acquire(blocked)
 record("lock-path-directory", err, nil)
 return result
}

func TestCaptureOldGo(t *testing.T) {
 contents, err := json.MarshalIndent(captureLockObservations(t),"","  ")
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 if err := os.WriteFile("captured.json", append(contents,'\n'),0600); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
}
